page.overview:
Who is Kodai Burkan?

Kodai Burkan was a Human male who was active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. He collaborated with the Imperials by making deliveries between the city of Sobrik and the Troida Military Workshop.
